command: set -euo pipefail; adb logcat -c; adb shell am force-stop io.blueeye; adb shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/tmp/tracker-launch.txt 2>&1; sleep 2; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; echo PID=$PID; adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-window.xml >/dev/null; adb shell cat /sdcard/tracker-window.xml | tr '>' '>\n' | head -n 120
